title: Startup reaches the initial run configuration
statement: Let $S$ be a finite-state deterministic Boolean machine, let $A$ be a nondeterministic Boolean machine, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $m,T$ be natural numbers. Suppose $S$ halts on input $x$ after exactly $T$ steps with output consisting of $m$ true symbols, and $|x|\le m$. Then there is a natural number $s_0\le T+m+2$ and a choice of work-tape contents and head positions for $S$ such that, for every Boolean word $w$ of length $s_0$, running the host machine on input $x$ using choices $w$ for that many steps yields the run configuration encoding the initial configuration of $A$ on $x$, with clock value zero and those work-tape contents and head positions for $S$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite-state deterministic Boolean machine
$S$ computes the word of $m$ true symbols from $x$ in exactly $T$ steps
there exist work-tape contents and head positions for $S$
the conclusion holds for every Boolean word $w$ of length $s_0$
